# Golden console lines for the Cal Routine's 259e run (src/Cal259eFlow.h,
# Cal259eLines). test_cal259e_flow.cpp checks the firmware formatter produces
# each of these byte for byte, that the flow logs exactly these CALR# header
# lines at the start of a run, and that every CALR line of a simulated run has
# its header's field count. tools/hwqa/cvmeter.py parses the same SUBs.
# Change one side and the other fails.
#
# Shape: CALR v2 (as fixtures/calr_lines.txt): CALR,<SUB>,<field>,... with no
# spaces, fixed decimals. ch is the 259e channel, 0 = principal pitch, 1 =
# modulation pitch. addr and gain_hex are upper-case hex (addr 2 digits, gain
# 4); rec60hex is the 30-byte record as 60 upper-case hex digits; n is the
# number of fresh ADC samples in raw_median. result is OK, a fail name, or
# CANCELLED_<commit result> when a cancel came after the COMMIT went out.
# 259BK is one preset-backup attempt: addr, the bytes the bus master moved (990
# for a good bank), the CRC-32 of the stored bank (8 hex digits) and OK or why not.
# The RETRY and REREAD lines are the meter rule's (MeterMeasure), as in a Self
# run; their headers are calr_lines.txt's.
CALR#,version=2
CALR#,259START,addr
CALR#,259PT,ch,mv,meter_mv,raw_median,n
CALR#,259FIT,ch,gain_hex,offset,worst_cents,nonlin_cents
CALR#,259REC,addr,rec60hex
CALR#,259END,result
CALR#,259BK,addr,bytes,crc_hex,result
CALR#,RETRY,scpi,attempt
CALR#,REREAD,out,target_mv,code,spread_mv
CALR,259START,29
CALR,259PT,0,4800,4800.123,29076,8
CALR,259FIT,1,8F2C,-120,-1.23,0.45
CALR,259REC,28,434C015902000102030405060708000268FAC1808F2CFF889041000FB49E
CALR,259END,COMMIT_UNKNOWN
CALR,259BK,28,990,1A2B3C4D,OK
CALR,RETRY,READ?,2
CALR,REREAD,1,3600,19661,0.734
